title: Certify an exact QQ16 B1 prefix inverse before child 11795
body:
## Summary

```text
literal B_1_2 prefix [0,11795)
  16 private CLEAR epochs -> controlled shears with disjoint controls/targets
  704 ordinary fields    -> constructive exact inverse
  compatible local collision -> conditional hybrid-prefix lift
```

Certify the exact-prefix reachability obligation left open by #3258. Completed native/cover maps must be exact invertible maps; private fields enter and leave zero. This does not establish a fully rounded producer collision. The local-to-full-cut native embedding, F0 output image, caller entry format and physical bill remain open. No supplier or new kappa.

Package: `research/qq16-b1-prefix-reachability/`. It retains #3258's proof unchanged and credits #3250 and the QQ16/native lineage. The local collision and its information bounds remain predecessor results.

## Evidence

- **Before:** a local child/half-ADD collision does not by itself establish reachability through the preceding program, which contains 32 private CLEARs.
- **After:** all 16 actual private epochs have disjoint ordinary read/write sets, giving a constructive inverse under the stated exact-map contracts. Nine full-state noncommuting GL4 substitution fixtures round-trip; these are algebraic checks, not actual native payload execution.

Registered CPython3.12.15 replay, a separately implemented source-flow checker, eight optimized behavioral groups, CPython3.13.5 checks, Ruff and all 12 committed package/input byte comparisons pass locally.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-b1-prefix-reachability
```

The only external runtime input is a canonical-main certificate. Pending proof sources are committed byte-identical exports, so clean CI needs no unrelated pending Git objects. Scope, exact pins, commands and Open next questions are in the README. Hosted CI is tracked separately on the final head.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Adds one opt-in research package. No frozen predecessor, shared verifier or selected-frontier change. Native embedding, full producer numerics, caller format and supplier admission are not certified.
